title: Login Issues & Troubleshooting
content: Steps to resolve login failures: 1. Verify email and password accuracy. 2. Ensure Caps Lock is off. 3. Clear browser cache or switch browsers (Chrome/Firefox/Safari). 4. Use the 'Forgot Password' link if credentials are lost. Persistent failures may indicate a locked account for security.

title: Password Reset Procedure
content: To reset a password: Click 'Forgot Password' on the login screen, enter your registered email, and click the link sent to your inbox. Note: Reset links are time-sensitive and expire after 60 minutes for security. Check spam folders if the email is not received.

title: Account Creation & Verification
content: New users can register via the 'Sign Up' button. Requirements: Name, valid email, and a secure password. A mandatory verification email is sent upon submission. Account activation is only completed after the user clicks the verification link in that email.

title: Managing Payment Methods
content: Path: Settings > Billing > Add Payment Method. Supported formats: Credit cards (Visa/Mastercard), Debit cards, and PayPal. Users can set a 'Primary' payment method or remove expired cards at any time. All transactions are encrypted.

title: Subscription Plans & Changes
content: Manage subscriptions via Account Settings > Subscription. Users can Upgrade (immediate effect), Downgrade (takes effect next cycle), or Cancel. Cancellation stops future billing but maintains access until the current period expires.

title: Refund Policy and Requests
content: Refunds are eligible for accidental purchases or technical errors within 30 days. Submit requests via the Help Center 'Refund Form'. Approved refunds are credited to the original payment method within 5-10 business days.

title: Privacy and Data Sharing Settings
content: Control data visibility in Account > Privacy Settings. Options include profile visibility (Public/Private), marketing data sharing toggles, and third-party app permissions. We recommend reviewing these quarterly.

title: Notification Preferences
content: Users can customize alerts via Settings > Notifications. Channels include Email, SMS, and In-app Push. Essential security alerts and billing receipts cannot be disabled for account safety.

title: Permanent Account Deletion
content: To close an account: Settings > Delete Account. This action is irreversible and erases all personal data, history, and active subscriptions. Requires password re-authentication to prevent accidental deletion.

title: Editing User Profile Details
content: Update personal info at Profile > Edit. Modifiable fields: Display name, profile picture, and contact phone number. Changes to the primary email address require a secondary verification step.
